title: Chief Minister of Assam meets Prime Minister
body_text:
Chief Minister of Assam, Shri Himanta Biswa Sarma met Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi today in New Delhi.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X;
“Chief Minister of Assam, Shri @himantabiswa met Prime Minister @narendramodi.
@CMOfficeAssam”
Chief Minister of Assam, Shri @himantabiswa met Prime Minister @narendramodi . @CMOfficeAssam pic.twitter.com/1aCq6XP1Cq — PMO India (@PMOIndia) August 20, 2026
***
MJPS/SS/ST

enrichment.summary: The Chief Minister of Assam, Himanta Biswa Sarma, met Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi on 20 August 2026. The meeting was announced via a brief social media post from the PMO with no details on the agenda or outcomes.
enrichment.context: This is a routine courtesy or administrative meeting between a state Chief Minister and the Prime Minister, a common occurrence that typically involves discussion of state-specific development projects, central funding, or political matters. Such meetings are frequently held but rarely disclosed in detail, and this release provides no substantive policy content, agreement, or decision.

related_articles.relationship: Both are brief PMO announcements of a state Chief Minister meeting the Prime Minister in Delhi with no agenda disclosed, part of a recurring pattern of such CM-PM meetings.
